title: Design: A no-charge line shows the No Charge chip and $0.00, no work order badge
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a regular customer (not flagged), with one asset.
  • Have a new billable work order for the regular customer, not invoiced, with two lines: each with 1.0 h of labor and one stock part with a cost, made for this test.
  • Mark the second line No Charge with the category Warranty.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow6-03-03-line-marked-no-charge-0-00-v14.png, iwo-happy-32-32-line-marked-no-charge-0-00-v14.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the billable work order.
  2. Hover over the "No Charge" chip on the second line.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The second line shows the chip "No Charge" next to its title; its Rate, Total and every part on it show $0.00 and Margin shows nothing.
  • The chip shows only the words "No Charge", with no category name in it.
  • The work order header has no badge and no orange style.

Step 2:

  • A tooltip reads "Category: Warranty".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.4 (13 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 14 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S12-R3: “A no-charge line shows the chip "No Charge" next to its title on the lines table, in Tech View and on mobile, with the tooltip "Category: [category]" on hover, as the work order badge has (S2-R16); the category itself is not printed in the chip; Rate, Total and every part on it show $0.00; Margin shows nothing. Hours, technician, status, approval, parts ordering, picking, receiving, clock-ins, notes, inspections and the story work as on any line. The original work order and line are not shown on the line; they are in the notes, the Audit Log, the report and the hub record.”
  • S12-R4: “The work order carries no badge and no header style and its classification stays billable; Financial Info (the cost view) does not change.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794565397-7f4c (read and rendered 14 Nov 2026: from version 1794561577-f903 one string changed, the chip of a no-charge line now reads "No Charge" on 6 boards; the other 161 boards are pixel-identical): pages "Flow 6 · Move one line off a billable work order" / "Happy flow v6", boards "03 Line marked No Charge · $0.00" (Flow 6 · Move one line off a billable work order), "32 Line marked No Charge · $0.00" (Happy flow v6).

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • iwo-flow6-03-03-line-marked-no-charge-0-00-v14.png
  • iwo-happy-32-32-line-marked-no-charge-0-00-v14.png

The design's own words:

  • “No Charge”
  • “$0.00”

Difference IWO-D63 on S12-R3 (chip text): closed, the design (version 1794565397-7f4c) draws the chip "No Charge" as PRD v1.4 S12-R3 says.

Register IWO-N45 on S12-R3 (design silent): the boards draw the chip "No Charge" but no tooltip; PRD v1.4 S12-R3 states the tooltip "Category: [category]" on hover, so this case follows the PRD.
